cohort: The cohort consisted of 63 consecutive patients with a mean age of 53 years (range 21-88) who underwent vesico-vaginal fistula repair under a single surgeon between 2006 and 2014.
finding: The Goh classification did not predict anatomical closure rates (90% at first attempt, 100% overall) of vesico-vaginal fistulae in the developed world, but it correlated with post-anatomical closure continence, which deteriorated with increasing classification type; additionally, smaller fistula size and younger patient age predicted success.
